cortex.instance.AddSource/outcome/added.purpose: `cortex.instance.AddSource` answers `added` for an input no other branch's guard claims

cortex.instance.CreateInstance/outcome/c.purpose: `cortex.instance.CreateInstance` answers `connection-missing` for the cause it declares as external, injected
`cortex.instance.CreateInstance` answers `created` for an input no other branch's guard claims

cortex.instance.CreateInstance/outcome/n.purpose: `cortex.instance.CreateInstance` sent twice for one identity takes `name-taken` the second time, on every creating path, and leaves the row as the first call made it

cortex.instance.CreateInstance/outcome/s.purpose: `cortex.instance.CreateInstance` answers `seed-refused` for the cause it declares as external, injected

cortex.instance.EnableSource/outcome/ena.purpose: `cortex.instance.EnableSource` answers `enabled` for an input no other branch's guard claims

cortex.instance.EnableSource/outcome/no-.purpose: `cortex.instance.EnableSource` for an identity no record carries takes `no-such-source` and reports `cortex.instance.SourceNotFound`

cortex.instance.Instance/state/Removed/r.purpose: `cortex.instance.RemoveInstance` does not move a `cortex.instance.Instance` that is in `Removed`, and reports `cortex.instance.InstanceNotActive`

cortex.instance.RecordFailure/outcome/co.purpose: `cortex.instance.RecordFailure` answers `counted` for an input no other branch's guard claims

cortex.instance.RecordFailure/outcome/di.purpose: `cortex.instance.RecordFailure` answers `disabled` for an independently observed subject enum fact and an eligible input

cortex.instance.RecordFailure/outcome/no.purpose: `cortex.instance.RecordFailure` for an identity no record carries takes `no-such-source` and reports `cortex.instance.SourceNotFound`

cortex.instance.RemoveInstance/outcome/r.purpose: `cortex.instance.RemoveInstance` answers `removed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

cortex.instance.RunSource/outcome/apply-.purpose: `cortex.instance.RunSource` answers `apply-refused` for the cause it declares as external, injected

cortex.instance.RunSource/outcome/disabl.purpose: `cortex.instance.RunSource` answers `disabled` for an input no other branch's guard claims

cortex.instance.RunSource/outcome/extrac.purpose: `cortex.instance.RunSource` answers `extraction-failed` for the cause it declares as external, injected

cortex.instance.RunSource/outcome/fetch-.purpose: `cortex.instance.RunSource` answers `fetch-failed` for the cause it declares as external, injected

cortex.instance.RunSource/outcome/no-suc.purpose: `cortex.instance.RunSource` for an identity no record carries takes `no-such-source` and reports `cortex.instance.SourceNotFound`

cortex.instance.RunSource/outcome/ran.purpose: `cortex.instance.RunSource` answers `ran` for an input selecting the branch in its established subject state

cortex.instance.Source/invariant/after/c.purpose: a `cortex.instance.Source` still satisfies what it declares after `cortex.instance.AddSource` on `added`
a `cortex.instance.Source` still satisfies what it declares after `cortex.instance.EnableSource` on `enabled`
a `cortex.instance.Source` still satisfies what it declares after `cortex.instance.RecordFailure` on `counted`
a `cortex.instance.Source` still satisfies what it declares after `cortex.instance.RecordFailure` on `disabled`
a `cortex.instance.Source` still satisfies what it declares after `cortex.instance.RunSource` on `ran`

cortex.instance.Source/state/Disabled/re.purpose: `cortex.instance.RecordFailure` does not move a `cortex.instance.Source` that is in `Disabled`, and reports `cortex.instance.SourceDisabledError`
`cortex.instance.RunSource` refuses in held state `Disabled` without effects

cortex.instance.Source/state/Enabled/ref.purpose: `cortex.instance.EnableSource` does not move a `cortex.instance.Source` that is in `Enabled`, and reports `cortex.instance.SourceNotDisabled`

cortex.instance.UpdateInstance/outcome/s.purpose: `cortex.instance.UpdateInstance` answers `seed-change-refused` for an independently observed subject enum fact and an eligible input

cortex.instance.UpdateInstance/outcome/u.purpose: `cortex.instance.UpdateInstance` answers `updated` for an input no other branch's guard claims
